name.en: The Sun God Leading Down into Darkness
name.ja: <ruby>闇<rt>やみ</rt></ruby>へ<ruby>誘<rt>いざな</rt></ruby>う<ruby>太<rt>たい</rt></ruby><ruby>陽<rt>よう</rt></ruby><ruby>神<rt>しん</rt></ruby>

text.en: Activate this card by sending 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monster from your hand, Deck, or face-up field to the GY. During your Main Phase, if this card was activated this turn: You can add 1 "Sun God" monster from your Deck to your hand. If a monster(s) is destroyed by battle: Its controller takes damage equal to its original ATK, then if you have "The Winged Dragon of Ra" in your GY, you gain 1000 LP. You can only use each effect of "The Sun God Leading Down into Darkness" once per turn.
text.zh-CN: 从手牌・牌组・场上（表侧表示）将1只“拉之翼神龙”怪兽送至墓地可以发动此卡。此卡名的①②效果1回合仅可各使用1次。①：在发动了此卡的回合的自己的主要阶段可以发动。从牌组将1只“太阳神”怪兽加入手牌。②：有怪兽因战斗被破坏的情况下发动。被破坏的怪兽的控制者受到相当于其原本攻击力数值的伤害。自己墓地存在“拉之翼神龙”的情况下，自己进而恢复1000LP。
